items.title: Updated: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: Updated: Sustainability tools to use in 2026
items.summary: Welcome to the Trellis roundup of new products and services for sustainability professionals, as chosen by our editorial team.

items.title: Pharma companies team up to reduce heat-related emissions
items.summary: Pharmaceutical companies Sanofi, Opella and UCB have joined AstraZeneca as founders of the Clean Heat Program, which aims to reduce the use of fossil fuel-generated heat in industrial processes by helping companies transition to low-carbon alternatives.

items.title: Are CEOs more confident than their staff about reaching net-zero by 2050?
items.summary: UK business leaders are far more confident than frontline employees that their organisations will meet the 2050 net-zero target, as new research reveals a divide in awareness of corporate sustainability plans.

items.title: edie 27: First speakers revealed for UK’s premier sustainable business event
items.summary: edie is excited to announce some of the leading green economy and business voices who will be speaking at edie 27 next April, including leaders from WWF, Liverpool Football Club, Heineken, Lenovo and Ferrero.

items.title: In practice: Innovations accelerating regenerative agriculture adoption
items.summary: With businesses struggling to communicate sustainability endeavours transparently and dealing with short-term budget constraints, edie’s new ‘in practice’ series explores how some organisations are trialling and installing innovative projects to deliver climate action.

items.title: France falls short of emissions target despite 2026 reductions
items.summary: France's emissions are set to fall 2.8% this year, but analysts warn that drop isn't enough to keep the country on track for its 2030 goal.

items.title: Banks retreat from climate targets as net-zero commitments weaken
items.summary: New research has revealed that banks globally are scaling back climate commitments, weakening policies on lending to high-emission companies and disclosing less information about their transition plans.

items.title: Study: 76% of UK investors expect sustainability to shape business decisions
items.summary: Over three-quarters of UK retail investors expect sustainability to feature in business or investment decisions, with governance standing out as a key ESG differentiator.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: The future cost of EV charging – what businesses can’t afford to overlook
items.summary: Join edie on 22 October for our 45-minute masterclass, 'The Future Cost of EV Charging,' delivered in partnership with Brook Green Supply.
